items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: We brought in Larry Willis on piano, Earl May on drums... This group was dynamite.

ctx.x: Yeah. Just a little bit more about this Playboy Club gig, did you get people coming up and asking for requests and sort of play them on the spot or did you pretty much get left alone?

No we got — okay so the Playboy was with Monty and Bob, there were hardly requests. Because these guys are monster musicians. You want to hear the guy play, you don’t want to pigeon hole him into one little song that your daughter likes or something like that. Yeah. I don’t remember requests coming in. But let me tell you what happened at this Playboy Club. After about maybe eight months or so Bob — I’m sorry Monty got a call for a job at Jilly’s and that was a nightclub in Manhattan that Sinatra used to hang out…
